healthDescription: Health is not a single ping. The agent, host, network, tunnel, V2bX, DNS, end-to-end connectivity, and standby readiness are assessed separately.
dependencyBody: The user depends on the domain, the domain on the Iran server, the Iran server on the tunnel, and the tunnel on V2bX on the foreign server. A failure in one layer does not necessarily break the others.
